title: Represent mutually exclusive damage modes in non-creature spell damage lists (fire-shield, spirit-guardians)
description: Found by eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1.1 O3 sweep. spell:fire-shield prints '2d8 fire damage from a warm shield, or 2d8 cold damage from a cold shield' and spell:spirit-guardians prints '3d8 radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 necrotic damage (if you are evil)'. Both project mechanics.damage as a cumulative list ([2d8 fire, 2d8 cold]; [3d8 radiant, 3d8 necrotic]). Needs a damage-list alternative representation (creature attacks use attacks[].alternatives from eshyra-o9bd.19.4.2.1 / PR 646, which is not on the current base). Decide the representation, then repair both plus audit the sibling spells found by the same grammar. Not a parser-strategy change under the owning bead's HARD STOP, so it was not done under 19.3.1.1.
close_reason: Absorbed into eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1 (same PR; O3 cross-kind damage alternatives are this bead's scope; representation decided by the Captain, see 19.3.1 notes)
